name: Impostor
source:
Impostor. That is the name of the one among you that is the murderer. Will you be able to find who it is? I guess we'll see. 

[From [url=https://portdev.itch.io/impostor]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
「冒牌貨」。你們中間那個殺人兇手就叫這名字。你能把兇手找出來嗎？那就走著瞧吧。

［摘自[url=https://portdev.itch.io/impostor]Itch.io[/url]］
